content.introduction: In the week from November 2 to November 8, 2026, 1,315 companies are scheduled to report earnings, including Apple (AAPL) on November 2 after the close, Advanced Micro Devices (AMD) on November 3 after the close, Palantir Technologies - Class A (PLTR) on November 2 after the close, Amgen (AMGN) on November 3 after the close and Toyota Motor (TM) on November 5 before the open. AMD rose 118% through November 2 vs gains of 41% for the VanEck Semiconductor ETF (SMH) and 11% for the S&P 500, outperformance supported by strong demand from data centers for its enterprise CPUs and its AI accelerators, as well as the expectation said demand will persist.
body:
AMD rose 118% through November 2 vs gains of 41% for the VanEck Semiconductor ETF (SMH) and 11% for the S&P 500, outperformance supported by strong demand from data centers for its enterprise CPUs and its AI accelerators, as well as the expectation said demand will persist.
